title: UI receipt cross-book requirements and world-specific sharing
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual content review; source-window confidence and shared presentation versus local mechanics
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original626–925: complete remaining44-group registry table, MC59–MC96/world routing sweep, round6 remaining-source windows/MC97–MC118 and round7/MC119–MC126/MC127 opening. B562–B564 cover original1–925 only. Original926–1174 and appended notes remain. Each table row was read, not merely its count; no linked source novel/corpus/brief is implicitly qualified by this review.

F2: Round5 extracted-record samples and round6 one contextual window per28 missing-direct-output groups plus10 targeted windows differ. Lexically first shard is not chronological opening; word match, reader S/T/I tag and renamed file are not source truth. Registered-only groups retain uncertainty, and the five titled Chinese works remain separate. Pale Lights no acquired wiki revision and the small tree-root window cannot certify full patron/forest-control laws. Proposed first questions for each source stay useful without inventing a book-specific engine from an uninformative excerpt. No new reading/acquisition wave follows.

F3: MC59–MC76 preserve objective/protected subject, participant/body/controller, ranged hit set, casting phase, retained aftermath, source of message, public identity and exact clock. Rank is not a win percentage; lost information link need not kill an entity; capture/defeat/death/offer/surrender differ. A remote information channel cannot alone authorize physical action, while a source-supported extraordinary link can. Source-ordinary weakness, terms or body change need not be universal all-world limits. No mandatory fight, loot, XP, injury, suspicion or live unseen opponent locator is supplied by choosing a representation.

F4: MC77–MC96 preserve actual workpiece/parts, thermal process versus pure law, composition versus worn effect, accountable fractions/residue, preparation lot versus dose/body, instrument reading versus material truth, and ritual/request/responding agent versus deterministic chemistry. Chemical conservation is not universal magic law. Unknown properties can still physically work; a stronger source can create or transform through its actual mechanism. Experiments and repeated setups yield attributed scope, not an arbitrary universal recipe or one compatibility percentage. Apparatus cleanliness, upkeep, formation geometry and vows apply only when actual consumers read them. AD51 qualifies old two-consumer-before-sharing language; each local law remains owned.

F5: MC97–MC118 section grouping is selected scope/commitment/lifetime, not a new mandatory panel registry or descriptor. A subject draft cannot silently target a newly selected person; same disabled-reason string is not same support identity. Stable sibling updates can preserve focus/draft without freezing real clocks. Circuit design/testing, institutional evidence/disposition/capacity, stationary-body influence, source-specific rate metric and old clinical hypothesis are distinct consumers. Proposed API/forecast is not completed experiment, diagnosis or source proof. Public credentials, ownership, voting weight and instrument saturation cannot be summed into one status. Unknown current patient/body/support requires its real refreshed quote.

F6: MC119–MC126 preserve care versus feed/charge/service, acquisition/control/understanding/use, reusable participant versus consumed ingredient and independent attainment/rank/resource/title. The novice Gu hungry-but-usable versus keeper starved-out distinction is an attributed pack-policy counterexample, not universal source hunger. No shared red badge imposes a common lock. Territory producer clocks, local custody, exports and current-holder access differ; forecast changes do not rewrite prior paid terms or migrate stock. Current book priorities, AD16/AD36/AD42/AD43 and actual owner/source decide selected proof. No gameplay, images/browser, private save/source artifacts, migration, worker, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Actual original626–925 read in four bounded untruncated outputs. B562/B563 actual1–625; no underlying source or current behavior credit.
reviews.reopen: Continue original926–1174 and appended notes; verify unchanged original-prefix identity before cumulative full credit.
